team.collaboration: Free discussion among the six teammates. One shared answer sheet.

execution.wall_clock_note: Official ARML Local team round is about 45 minutes; max_turns is a safety budget.
execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock 9 turns vs floor 26 (6 teammates x 2 turns + 10 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
Paper and pencil only; calculators are banned on every ARML round.
No phones, computers, internet, books, or notes.
Collaborate freely within the six-person team.
Submit one shared short-answer sheet; answers are usually exact values.
Do not look up contest archives or answer keys.
Teams of six students; schools may field multiple teams.
Team Round: 45 minutes; set of 15 short-answer questions worked by the entire team together.
Also Individual (5×10 min pairs) and Relay (6/8/10 min structures) — benchmark track focuses on team round.
National no-calculator / no-electronics bans apply across ARML contests; Local inherits paper/pencil only expectation.
Coaches/local coordinators grade and submit scores.

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: captain and answer-sheet synthesizer
duties: Keep the shared answer sheet coherent and complete.
Assign remaining unsolved problems when discussion stalls.
Submit the final numbered team answers.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: algebra specialist
duties: Lead algebra, functions, equations, and logarithmic problems.
Check algebraic simplifications before answers enter the sheet.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: geometry specialist
duties: Lead geometry, area, trigonometry, and diagram-based reasoning.
State assumptions clearly when a diagram is incomplete in text.

agent_roles.name: Agent_4
agent_roles.title: probability and combinatorics specialist
duties: Lead counting, probability, and expected-value problems.
Write exact fractions in lowest terms when required.

agent_roles.name: Agent_5
agent_roles.title: number theory and discrete specialist
duties: Lead number theory, modular arithmetic, and discrete constructions.
Cross-check integer answers for off-by-one and divisibility mistakes.

agent_roles.name: Agent_6
agent_roles.title: independent verifier
duties: Challenge weak arguments and demand an independent check.
Scan the answer sheet for missing problems before submission.

scoring.notes: Official team round awards fixed points per correct short answer; local env uses gold matching / LLM judge for partial credit.

rules_text: ARML Local Team Round: six students, shared answer sheet, paper and pencil only. No calculators, phones, internet, books, or notes. Collaborate freely, then submit one official set of short answers. Official timing note: About 45 minutes.
